findings.title: The sample panel shows only tide times, not what makes Tidewell different from an almanac

location.description: the "Today at Porthmellin" panel on the right of the hero

findings.viewer_experience: A harbor master sees a table their almanac already gives them. Lock gate times, pontoon depth and notices appear only as text claims in the notes below, and nothing compares Tidewell with how the office posts this today.

current.value: 4 rows, low and high water only, with time and height

findings.target: The panel shows a gate-time row, a pontoon depth reading, one notice, and a short before-and-after against the office's current method.
findings.fix_direction: Add a gate-time row, a pontoon depth reading, one notice, and a short before-and-after against the office's current method. The maker must supply the real gate times, depth figures, notice text and current method; do not invent them.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the "Today at Porthmellin" panel holds a gate-time row, a pontoon depth reading, a notice, and a before-and-after comparison, not only low and high water rows.

findings.title: The word "quay." sits alone on the last line of the hero paragraph

location.description: the hero paragraph under the headline

findings.viewer_experience: A one-word last line looks like a small slip.

current.value: last line is the single word "quay."

findings.target: the last line has at least two words
findings.fix_direction: Make the paragraph a little narrower or a little wider so the last line has at least two words.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, tablet and widescreen images, the last line of the hero paragraph has at least two words.

findings.title: The first two feature notes on the phone run short of 45 characters per line

location.description: the first feature note under the tide table on the phone

findings.viewer_experience: They still read normally at this width.
findings.fix_direction: Reduce the side padding a little, or accept the shortfall at this width.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.points > div.point:nth-of-type(1) > p and section.points > div.point:nth-of-type(2) > p in the phone viewport is 45 or more
